giver: Brian, at the pool bar in south Key Lento
steps: Talk to Brian at the pool bar
Pick up Cal at the liquor store
Search the pink area south on Maroon Key for Arnold
Chase his car, shoot the biker henchmen, then chase on foot to the docks
Choose to kill or spare Arnold
tips: Either choice gives the same outcome
Press L3 + R3 in the car chase to slow time and aim
Stunt jumps on the bridge ramps stay marked under the Exploration map filter
